items.title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
items.summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.

items.title: 1 Industrials Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and the industry is currently lagging as its six-month return of 2.1% has trailed the S&P 500’s 13% gain.
